captured_sources.text: “Release dates of the Climate Monitoring U.S. National and Global monthly reports and the Billion-Dollar Weather and Climate Disasters quarterly reports are tentatively scheduled and as such are subject to change. Definitive release dates are determined no later than one week prior to a report’s release and all public calendars will be updated accordingly.”

captured_sources.fact: JS loads exactly /monitoring-content/lib/reference/monthly-releases.json. It defines only scopes national=U.S. National and global=Global, filters future records by those report labels, and renders separate tables; no tornadoes product scope.

comparison.current_shell_header: October U.S. Release: Mon, 9 Nov 2026, 11:00 AM EST
comparison.fact: Current official general schedule supplies October U.S. National and Global monthly-report dates (Nov 9 and Nov 12 respectively). It contains no separately labeled tornadoes release/date. Therefore this schedule confirms the general U.S. National report date but does not itself establish or refute a distinct tornadoes time-series/count release on frozen Nov 11; schedule article says dates tentative and definitive dates no later than one week before report.

limits: The schedule article concerns Climate Monitoring U.S. National/Global monthly reports and separate quarterly disasters reports; no tornadoes category is listed in the loaded JS/data.
No claim that NCEI lacks another tornado-specific release notice or that the frozen criterion changes; this bounded schedule inspection is not an exhaustive search.
Times are call-window bounds, supplied response-byte hashes; not wire-level authentication. Raw bodies remain in private logs.
